name: Doodle Date
source:
Romance, seduce, and even marry your own drawings! Forget about finding true love; In Doodle Date, you create it! 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/830980/Doodle_Date/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
与你亲手画出的角色谈恋爱、诱惑他们，甚至和他们结婚！忘掉寻找真爱吧；在《涂鸦约会》中，真爱由你亲手创造！

（来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/830980/Doodle_Date/]Steam[/url]）
